It's getting harder to talk in general, I just have very little to say, even to my friends. I've been feeling pretty down lately too, just a real low mood, but these other things, the smells, the strange words, and the constant worry about my girlfriend, they were happening even before I started feeling this sad, and they're still very much here, every single day, regardless of how I'm feeling emotionally.

It's been with me for much longer than just these past few months, making it almost impossible to even get out of bed.
